## S2 · S2-rt-unsafe-budget — Miri fix needs redoubt-rt unsafe 10 -&gt; 11

Status: **resolved** · Assigned to: Orchestrator · Revision: 3

Evidence: Orchestrator ruling (A): redoubt-rt unsafe budget 10-&gt;11 with the soundness fix, reason stated in the commit (per-borrow views replace a stored &'static mut the kernel's page move aliased); merging heap accesses to hold the count refused as gaming it.

### Implementer · Question

Event: `6e334a851348200975f5fe0cccc96941` · 2026-09-28T09:53:21Z

> Blocking, rule: unsafe ratchet only falls (tests/unsafe-budget.toml, redoubt-rt max_unsafe = 10).
> 
> Miri finding (rt-page-view-aliasing) is a REAL aliasing bug, not a harness artefact: ipc.rs `Mapping` stores `bytes: &'static mut [u8]`. A `Buffer` passed by value into `Endpoint::call` has that field retagged and protected for the whole call frame (clearing it in into_pages does not end the protector), while the server adopts and writes the same pages. Same on the machine: the kernel moves the pages while the caller's frame still holds a protected &mut.
> 
> Fix (done, uncommitted): Mapping holds only (Pages, len) and makes a view per borrow: `bytes(&self)` and `bytes_mut(&mut self)`, each one documented unsafe; `release` goes. Plus a harness fix it exposed: the fake kernel now frees an abandoned call's lend on the reply, as kernel/ipc.md R3 says (Miri then reported the leak). Result: ipd grant_undo and ctl_deadline pass under Miri with Stacked AND Tree Borrows; rt echo/regressions/mapping_views/outcomes pass under Miri; cargo test of rt, bootfsd, consoled, keyd, ipd all 0.
> 
> Cost: rt unsafe 10 -> 11. A shared view needs its own unsafe (from_raw_parts), a mutable one its own; one site cannot serve both soundly. The only way to stay at 10 is to merge the heap's two free-list accesses, which is gaming the count.
> 
> Options: (A, recommended) raise redoubt-rt budget to 11 in this commit, commit message stating why; (B) keep 10 by merging the heap's read/write into one helper; (C) other.
> 
> I continue nothing else meanwhile (all other S2 work is committed: page 8 7acdb9f2f, rt timing 004ab3d61).

### Orchestrator · Answer

Event: `219cbaf95a88a3758ae2c0b66efde507` · 2026-09-28T09:53:30Z

> (A). The tenet is that the unsafe count goes up only with a stated reason, and closing a real aliasing bug (UB on the machine, not only under Miri) is one. Raise redoubt-rt's max_unsafe to 11 in the same commit as the fix. The commit body states it plainly: the Mapping held a &'static mut over pages the kernel moves while the caller's frame still protects it; views are now made per borrow, a shared one and a mutable one, each needing its own documented unsafe; one site cannot serve both soundly. Say what was deleted (release, the stored slice). Not (B): merging the heap's accesses to hold the number would be gaming the count. Commit the harness fix (the fake kernel freeing an abandoned call's lend on reply, per R3) separately, with its own reason. Close docs/todo/rt-page-view-aliasing.md with the fix, and state the change on the native page if it describes Mapping. Then report S2 complete for its final round, and fold your fix commits into their parents per CONTRIBUTING.md#commits.
